title: observability: token-level KV metrics, tracing dashboard and alert tuning
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Add token-level KV cache metrics, tracing instrumentation, Grafana dashboard for KV+token cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alerting rules to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage. This PR exposes new Prometheus metrics (kv_cache_hit_ratio, kv_cache_latency_ms, token_cost_per_request, token_latency_p50/p95/p99) tagged by model, region and customer_tier; adds tracing spans around KV lookup and cache population in the serving runtime; ships a Grafana dashboard with panels for token-level cost/latency split by cache hits/misses and model family; updates Prometheus recording rules and Alertmanager thresholds to cut down noisy alerts observed on warm cache churn; includes documentation updates and small test coverage for metric exposition. Motivation: ops and platform teams have been flooded by high-noise alerts tied to KV cache churn; teams need actionable per-token cost/latency signals to triage regressions and quantify economics of caching and batching. Checklist: - [x] Runtime metrics and tracing instrumentation added - [x] Prometheus scrape/config conventions followed - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON committed - [x] Alerting rules tuned with CI smoke tests - [x] Docs and migration notes added - [x] Unit/integration tests for metrics emission

change_summary: Adds runtime metrics and tracing for KV cache, token-level cost and latency metrics, Grafana dashboard for token-level cost/latency and KV hit/miss split, Prometheus recording rules, tuned alerts with grace windows, docs and helm chart updates. release_notes: Observability: Token-level KV metrics, tracing, dashboards and alert tuning. New metrics: kv_cache_hit_ratio, kv_cache_latency_ms, token_cost_per_request, token_latency_p50/p95/p99.
